选择界面显示语言。\n切换后需重启程序生效：界面文本是在窗口构建时就取定的，实时:
Choose the interface display language.
A restart is required for changes to take effect: UI text is fixed when the window is built; refreshing every control live would be error-prone and need extra caching of originals, which is not worth it.
Note: the English strings collected so far are mainly display names of internal IDs (action type / watermark position / view mode / conflict policy); other UI text will be filled in gradually as translation proceeds, and uncollected strings stay in Chinese for now.
设置 cjxl / djxl 转换进程的 CPU 优先级（默认低于正常，减少对前: Sets the CPU priority of cjxl / djxl conversion processes (default: below normal, to reduce impact on foreground work).
转换时并行使用的 CPU 核心数，决定同时转换的文件数（多文件时）或单个大文件的: Number of CPU cores used in parallel during conversion; decides how many files convert at once (multiple files) or the thread count for a single large file. "Auto" equals the machine's logical core count.
双队列调度器会根据「大图」判定把超大图独占满核、其余小图并行，从而充分利用 CP:
The dual-queue scheduler pins oversized images to all cores and runs the rest in parallel based on the "big image" judgment, to fully use the CPU. The threshold must be calibrated to this machine's CPU:
Clicking this button auto-generates test images, measures cjxl's multithreading speedup at different resolutions, and writes a suitable pixel threshold to settings—no parameter configuration needed.
On first launch, if not yet calibrated, it runs automatically once.
母开关：勾选以解锁下方各项高级参数，可逐项单独开启；取消勾选则全部恢复默认行为。:
Master switch: check to unlock the advanced parameters below, each can be enabled separately; uncheck to restore all default behavior.
(The first time you check it, a notice appears; you can tick "Don't remind me again" in the dialog.)
